report.candidate_letter:
Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the ML Engineer position. We will not move forward with your application, because your CV does not show these required points: experience with ML in production (3+ years of training, testing, deployment, monitoring), and experience with microservices architecture, cloud technologies, Docker, and Kubernetes.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
